City of Encinitas
San Dieguito Water District 5:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 15, 2014 -
5:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
S1.
CALL TO ORDER
San Dieguito Water District Board members receive an independent stipend of $100 for convening the Water District meetings pursuant to San Dieguito Water District Resolution No. 89-07.
S2.
ROLL CALL
S3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
S4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
S5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
(30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Board Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
S6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
S7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA
Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
S8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Board Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the 9/17/14 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2014-10-15 SDWD Item S8A - Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants List.
2014-10-15 SDWD Item S8B - Warrants
8C.
San Dieguito Water District's Quarterly Informational Update and Analysis. Contact Person: Assistant General Manager O'Donnell
Accept San Dieguito Water District's Quarterly Informational Update and Analysis.
2014-10-15 SDWD Item S8C -Quarterly Informational Update and Analysis
8D.
Cathodic Protection Systems Interconnection and Cost Sharing Agreement between Olivenhain Municipal Water District, Santa Fe Irrigation District and San Dieguito Water District. Contact Person: Assistant General Manager O'Donnell
Authorize the General Manager to enter into a Cathodic Protection Systems Interconnection and Cost Sharing Agreement between Olivenhain Municipal Water District, Santa Fe Irrigation District and San Dieguito Water District.
2014-10-15 SDWD Item S8D- Cathodic Protection Cost Sharing Agreement
8E.
Acceptance of City of Encinitas Tentative Map No. 09-135 Public Water Improvements. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Knoll
1) Accept the public water improvements; and 2) Authorize the General Manager to file a Notice of Completion.
2014-10-15 SDWD Item S8E - Public Water Improvements
S9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR
Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
S10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Consider Support of Proposition 1 - The Water Quality, Supply and Infrastructure Improvement Act of 2014. Contact Person: Assistant General Manager O'Donnell
Consider adoption of Resolution 2014-11, supporting Proposition 1 - The Water Quality, Supply and Infrastructure Improvement Act of 2014.
2014-10-15 SDWD Item S10A -Consider Support of Prop. 1
10B.
Amendment to and restatement of the March 17, 1998 agreement between the City of San Diego, Santa Fe Irrigation District and San Dieguito Water District regarding Lake Hodges. Contact Person: Assistant General Manager O'Donnell
Authorize the Board President to enter into an amendment to and restatement of the March 17,1998 agreement between the City of San Diego, Santa Fe Irrigation District and San Dieguito Water District regarding Lake Hodges.
2014-10-15 SDWD Item S10B - Amendment to Lake Hodges Agreement
S11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
11A.
Informational presentation on the Cardiff Park Homeowner's Association Turf Replacement Program. Contact Person: Assistant General Manager O'Donnell
District Board receive the report, discuss the information presented and provide direction as appropriate.
2014-10-15 SDWD Item S11A - Cardiff Park HOA Turf Replacement
11B.
Informational report on the results of the refinancing of the District's 2004 Water Revenue Bonds. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lembach
Receive the Informational Report.
2014-10-15 SDWD Item S11B - Presentation on Bond Refinancing
11C.
Informational presentation on the Drought and Response to the District's Declaration of a Drought Response Level 2 Condition. Contact Person: Assistant General Manager O'Donnell.
Receive the presentation, discuss the information presented and provide direction as appropriate.
2014-10-15 SDWD Item S11C - Presentation on Drought and Response to DRL2C
S12.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY BOARD MEMBERS
S13.
BOARD MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
S14.
GENERAL INFORMATION / STAFF STATUS REPORTS
S15.
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
